title: Human Resources job role for Recruitment
summary: Managing Recruitment roles and applications now needs the new Human Resources job role, or an Admin or Super Admin account.
changes: Add a Human Resources job role that can create, edit, publish, close, and delete Recruitment roles and review applications.
Stop giving Recruitment manage access to every staff, student, and volunteer account.
Keep Recruitment manage access for Admin and Super Admin accounts.
Add a local Human Resources test account.
version_rationale: Patch on the 0.41 line: tightens who can manage Recruitment with no new screens. Staff who manage Recruitment need the Human Resources job role after deploy.
validation: Recruitment, seeding, Access, and job role tests.
composer pre-merge on the pull request branch.
known_limitations: Staff without the Human Resources job role can still open an empty Recruitment roles list until a later 0.41 release.
rollback: Redeploy the previous release package. The Human Resources job role stays in the database and can be removed in Admin Access if needed.
